arc.fallback: The Miasma of the Void, Vanilla Ice

description.fallback: Telence suffers Star Platinum's punches, flying away, before crashing a hole through what appeared to be the sky. Surprised, Joseph concludes that their space is also a room in DIO's mansion; deciding to escape through the hole with Jotaro and Kakyoin. A dark and icy atmosphere emanates from a door at the top of a staircase, where a man bows in a crouch, his fist to the ground.
